sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks C4 (row 3) and Internal Quality Checks C4 (row 3, annotation cells all 'None')
evidence: instruction.md (5 lines, 3 paragraphs) and the six notes it references were read in full. Grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|<tag>|drive-letter or /Users|/home paths|turing-workspace|coldwater|hireops|author asides found nothing; the template's 'CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt the agent receives.' line is fully replaced. A manual pass over all 658 unique lowercase word types across brief+notes found no misspellings (outdent, contenteditable, WebAssembly, TipTap etc. are correct terms); British spelling is used consistently (colour/colours/Colouring, grey, behaviour.md, 'wraps round') with zero American variants; no doubled words. Cross-file facts are consistent and non-duplicated: the brief's 'six notes in /instructions' matches the six files COPYed to /instructions by environment/Dockerfile; 'node /app/server.js', '/app/app.db', '/assets/seed_data.json' and 'serve the workspace at /' in instruction.md:3-5 agree with integration.md:3,7,9 (one seed path, one DB path, one port 3000, no clock or account lists to conflict); 'no starter app' (instruction.md:3) agrees with integration.md:7 and the empty seed snippets array; the brief's 'run it beside the source' and overview.md:5 'keep the preview separate from where I edit' are compatible (side-by-side but distinct surfaces); library-freshness wording (overview.md:3 'stays current', behaviour.md:11 'within about five seconds') does not conflict. Weak/alternative test: a misreading app could not exploit a typo or stray path because none exists, and a conforming app is not put at risk by any contradictory pair of statements. Limitation: the private check-instruction-content.py / check-instruction-hygiene.py executables were not available in this worktree; preflight.json:268 only records a local grading-vocabulary guard (0 matches over 7 public files), so the mechanical half belongs to the deterministic reviewer, not this judgement row.
